serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Sorry, but he lives far away from here.
Policewoman: Huh? Can you at least give us his number?
You: S-sorry! I don’t know him that well. I talked with him on some anonymous forum.
Policewoman: So it's useless information…
Policewoman: Thank you for your attention sir, we will come again if any new questions arise. 
You: Have a good day…
